prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Goal: Production visual reference for a polished modern Roblox-inspired mining exploration game, rebuilt as a bright alpine mining village.
Scene: A flat grassy village clearing with a single square 16-metre-wide mining opening at its center, low rounded limestone coping on three sides and open approach from the foreground. To the left, a crafted cream plaster and timber workshop with a sweeping teal tiled roof, a small windmill and an ore cart. To the right, a welcoming ore exchange house with a coral tiled roof and blue-and-cream striped linen awning over a timber counter. A narrow turquoise stream and small arched wooden bridge run behind the mine; lush branching broadleaf trees lead into continuous green mountain slopes with pale rocky peaks.
Composition: Clear generous walkable paths from the flat foreground spawn to the central mine and right-hand trading counter; strong large silhouettes, coherent village scale, foreground grass and flowers, midground architecture, distant alpine ridges.
Camera: Actual playable third-person perspective, camera around 3 metres high and 12 metres back from the mine, looking slightly downward, 60-degree field of view, wide 16:9.
Materials: Sculpted organic vegetation with distinct leaf groupings, matte grass and earth, warm textured timber, rounded weathered limestone, woven awnings and glazed painted roof tiles with restrained highlights. No shiny plastic ground.
Lighting: Clear saturated blue sky with beautiful rounded white cumulus clouds. Warm afternoon sunlight from upper left, soft readable contact shadows, cool sky light in shadows, luminous vegetation. Bright clean colors without gray wash or bloom haze.
Palette: Lush emerald and yellow-green, cream, teal woodwork, coral roofs, honey timber and blue sky.
Constraints: No characters, no UI, no typography, no logos, no watermark. Do not assemble the landscape from cubes or polygon boulders. Ground-level spawn, no raised platform. No modern machinery, no urban city buildings.
Deliverable: A convincing finished game environment reference with consistent scale and buildable geometry, not a cinematic painting with vague architecture.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Seamlessly repeating square ground albedo texture for a stylized 3D mining game.
Primary request: Top-down orthographic painted lush meadow turf, only green grass coverage. Large soft patches of medium grassy green and warm yellow-green interlock, with restrained small curved blade brush marks. Polished modern stylized game texture, smooth shapes and subtly hand-painted organic variation.
Materials: Matte green grass, soft earthy organic color, no plastic. Base palette sRGB #59b249 with nearby #6db64c and #4fa649, small lighter blade tips. Keep medium contrast so the texture can cover a large landscape without noisy high contrast.
Lighting: Flat neutral albedo only, no directional lighting, cast shadows, ambient occlusion or highlights painted into the texture.
Composition: Flat square texture fills all edges, evenly distributed density, tileable left to right and top to bottom, no center focal point and no vignette. Actual top-down grass carpet with hints of individual blades, not tall grass seen from side.
Constraints: No rocks, no flowers, no dirt paths, no text, no border, no logos, no perspective, no objects, no sky.
Deliverable: Production diffuse color texture, 1024 square.
